method: Direct visual inspection of representative/full-resolution frames and all transition sheets, plus source, package and repository diff review.
visual_findings: Selected Mluva identity and original animated scenery remain clear in the opening/closing.
The first desktop shots use the exact Nord palette, generated shell settings and black-moon wallpaper.
Recording starts outside the workspace; it opens during the supplied spoken input.
The useful Live shot remains in the recording phase with steady equal panes. Early incomplete provisional content is excluded from this shot.
Copy, Polish, custom rewrite, typed editing, Save and Ctrl-P/search/Enter are visible native actions. Close crops keep text readable without tooltips or completed overlay clutter.
Captions remain legible, with no caption over the bright Rose Pine desktop. Fixture first-text timing labels are outside the close crops.
Every editorial boundary and both theme changes were inspected; cuts and native palette changes preserve an intelligible action sequence.

audio.auditory_listening: Not supported by this runner. Decoding, loudness and word alignment are separate checks, not pronunciation/listening approval.

Guest identity, installed entrypoint/hash checks, private display/D-Bus/AT-SPI/XDG/PipeWire, credential broker and package allowlist reviewed.

No blocker found in source binding, native assertions, encoder selection, camera/source ranges or final receipt verification.
